findings.location: Paragraph: "...every time tordenen rullet or she heard the words «tornado warning»,..."
findings.source_quote: every time the rumble of thunder was heard or she heard the words “tornado warning”, her heart would beat faster
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the quoted substantive phrase into contemporary Bokmål and keep it inside quotation marks. For example: «tornado warning» → «tornado-varsel» or «tornadovarsel». Replace only the quoted phrase and preserve surrounding punctuation and HTML structure.
findings.translation_quote: Gjennom den sommeren og i mange somre etterpå, hver gang tordenen rullet eller hun hørte ordene «tornado warning», slo hjertet hennes raskere, og en klump satte seg i magen.

findings.location: Paragraph: "“What was that?” exclaimed Mom as suddenly, a sheet of tin whizzed past the sunporch windows..."
findings.source_quote: a sheet of tin whizzed past the sunporch windows
findings.suggested_fix: Use a natural Norwegian rendering for “a sheet of tin” (a flat fragment/sheet of metal) rather than a compound that implies a pipe/tube. Suggested alternatives: «et stykke blikktak», «et stykke blikplate», «en blikplate», or «et stykke tinnplate» depending on desired register. Keep the rest of the sentence as translated.
findings.translation_quote: da et blikkplaterør suste forbi solverandavinduene og forsvant bortover hagen.
